profile.regional_context: Per InsideNoVA, WTOP, and DataCenterDynamics, Google announced a $1 billion expansion of its Loudoun and Prince William County data center campuses in April 2024, adding to its existing Loudoun County Data Center 1 and Data Center 2 sites.
profile.disclosure_policy: Google publishes aggregate state level investment figures on its data center location pages but does not publish exact addresses, square footage, or MW capacity for individual buildings
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Google's Northern Virginia data center campus, spanning Loudoun County (including a Leesburg/Stonewall Park site), and Prince William County.
